segments.text: We learned all about acids and bases in the general chemistry series, and we also learned
segments.zh: 我们在普通化学系列中学过了酸和碱的全部知识，也学过

segments.text: about the concept of an acid-base titration.
segments.zh: 酸碱滴定的概念。

segments.text: This is a neutralization reaction, where we use an acid or base of known concentration to
segments.zh: 这是一种中和反应，我们用已知浓度的酸或碱来

segments.text: determine the concentration of the other reagent.
segments.zh: 测定另一种试剂的浓度。

segments.text: This is because we can find the stoichiometric amount of acid or base titrant that must be
segments.zh: 这是因为我们可以求出恰好中和被分析物所需的

segments.text: used to precisely neutralize the analyte, and then use the volume of titrant added to calculate
segments.zh: 酸或碱滴定剂的化学计量用量，然后用加入的滴定剂体积来计算

segments.text: the concentration of the analyte.
segments.zh: 被分析物的浓度。

segments.text: For example, one mole of hydrochloric acid reacts with one mole of sodium hydroxide to
segments.zh: 例如，1 摩尔盐酸与 1 摩尔氢氧化钠反应，

segments.text: produce one mole of sodium chloride and one mole of water.
segments.zh: 生成 1 摩尔氯化钠和 1 摩尔水。

segments.text: Knowing the number of moles we add of one substance tells us something about the number
segments.zh: 知道我们加入的一种物质的摩尔数，就能告诉我们

segments.text: of moles of the other substance initially present.
segments.zh: 另一种物质最初存在的摩尔数的一些信息。

segments.text: The point at which the number of moles of acid and base precisely neutralize one another
segments.zh: 酸和碱的摩尔数恰好相互中和的那一点

segments.text: is called the equivalence point.
segments.zh: 称为化学计量点。

segments.text: To get to this point, you have to slowly add your acid or base little by little until
segments.zh: 要到达这一点，你必须一点一点地慢慢加入酸或碱，直到

segments.text: the reagents are exhausted, thus leaving only water and salt.
segments.zh: 反应物耗尽，只剩下水和盐。

segments.text: We have already gone over titration calculations in lecture-based tutorials, so that will not
segments.zh: 我们已经在讲授型的教程中讲过滴定计算，所以这里

segments.text: be the focus here, although we will discuss these calculations in a general way.
segments.zh: 不会以此为重点，不过我们会大致讨论一下这些计算。

segments.text: Rather than actually performing stoichiometric calculations, we are going to focus on the
segments.zh: 我们不会真的去做化学计量计算，而是重点讲

segments.text: details of physically performing the titration, which should help make any relevant calculations
segments.zh: 实际操作滴定的细节，这应该会让相关的计算

segments.text: easier to do.
segments.zh: 更容易进行。

segments.text: For example, we have already learned that to get to the equivalence point of a titration
segments.zh: 例如，我们已经学过，要到达强酸和强碱之间滴定的

segments.text: between a strong acid and base, like HCl and NaOH, we can measure the pH until we
segments.zh: 化学计量点，比如 HCl 和 NaOH，我们可以测量 pH，直到

segments.text: reach a pH of 7, since precisely equimolar amounts of strong acid and strong base will
segments.zh: pH 达到 7，因为摩尔数恰好相等的强酸和强碱

segments.text: leave only salt and water, which gives us neutral pH.
segments.zh: 只会剩下盐和水，从而得到中性的 pH。

segments.text: But rather than measuring pH, what we normally use in chemistry labs when performing titrations
segments.zh: 但在化学实验室里做滴定时，我们通常用的不是测 pH，

segments.text: is an indicator.
segments.zh: 而是指示剂。

segments.text: An indicator is a substance that exhibits a visible color change once the titration reaches
segments.zh: 指示剂是一种在滴定到达化学计量点时

segments.text: its equivalence point.
segments.zh: 会出现明显颜色变化的物质。

segments.text: For many acid-based titrations, a common indicator will be phenolphthalein.
segments.zh: 对于许多酸碱滴定，常用的指示剂是酚酞。

segments.text: This is because it turns bright pink as the solution is changing from acidic to basic,
segments.zh: 这是因为当溶液从酸性变为碱性时，它会变成鲜艳的粉红色，

segments.text: as upon having just neutralized all the acid, any additional base will react with phenolphthalein
segments.zh: 因为在刚好中和完所有的酸之后，任何多加的碱都会转而与酚酞

segments.text: instead, and it is the deprotonated form that glows pink, so as soon as we see this
segments.zh: 反应，而去质子化的形式呈现粉红色，所以一旦我们看到这种

segments.text: color persist in solution, we'll know that we're at the equivalence point.
segments.zh: 颜色在溶液中持续不褪，就知道到达化学计量点了。

segments.text: So to summarize, we start with an acid, we can add a bit of the indicator, and
segments.zh: 总结一下，我们从酸开始，可以加入一点指示剂，

segments.text: then titrate with a base.
segments.zh: 然后用碱滴定。

segments.text: Again, the solution will stay clear until it suddenly turns pink at the equivalence point,
segments.zh: 同样，溶液会一直保持无色，直到在化学计量点突然变成粉红色，

segments.text: notifying us that the titration is complete, and allowing us to do our calculations.
segments.zh: 提示我们滴定已经完成，这样我们就可以进行计算了。

segments.text: Today we will be using titration to find the concentration of a hydrochloric acid solution
segments.zh: 今天我们要用滴定来测定一份盐酸溶液的浓度，

segments.text: by using 0.1 molar sodium hydroxide as the titrant.
segments.zh: 使用 0.1 摩尔每升的氢氧化钠作为滴定剂。

segments.text: To start, we'll need a ring stand fixed with a burette clamp, an Erlenmeyer flask,
segments.zh: 首先，我们需要一个装有滴定管夹的铁架台、一个锥形瓶、

segments.text: a burette, a beaker, a glass funnel, our acid and our base, some indicator, and a graduated
segments.zh: 一支滴定管、一个烧杯、一个玻璃漏斗、我们的酸和碱、一些指示剂，以及一个

segments.text: cylinder.
segments.zh: 量筒。

segments.text: First, let's assemble our titration setup.
segments.zh: 首先，我们来组装滴定装置。

segments.text: We'll add our clean burette to the ring stand and clamp.
segments.zh: 我们把洗净的滴定管装到铁架台和夹子上。

segments.text: This is where we'll add our base, which again is referred to as the titrant in this
segments.zh: 我们要把碱加到这里，同样，在这里它被称为

segments.text: case.
segments.zh: 滴定剂。

segments.text: Our acid will go in an Erlenmeyer flask below the burette.
segments.zh: 我们的酸会装在滴定管下方的锥形瓶里。

segments.text: This is our analyte.
segments.zh: 这就是我们的被分析物。

segments.text: Before adding base to the burette, let's make sure it works correctly.
segments.zh: 在往滴定管里加碱之前，我们先确认它能正常工作。

segments.text: We can add water on top using a funnel.
segments.zh: 我们可以用漏斗从顶部加水。

segments.text: The burette can be tall, so you might need to lower it or step up on something.
segments.zh: 滴定管可能很高，所以你可能需要把它放低一些，或者站到什么东西上。

segments.text: Sometimes the stopcock leaks, and you don't want your base to leak out, as that will
segments.zh: 有时活塞会漏液，而你不希望碱漏出来，因为那会

segments.text: affect your calculation, so that's why we start with water.
segments.zh: 影响计算结果，所以我们先用水来试。

segments.text: After you see that there are no leaks, turn the stopcock parallel to the burette
segments.zh: 确认没有漏液后，把活塞转到与滴定管平行的位置

segments.text: to open it, making sure it is not clogged.
segments.zh: 打开它，确保没有堵塞。

segments.text: After you ensure that water flows well, remove all the water and close the stopcock.
segments.zh: 确认水流顺畅后，放掉所有的水并关闭活塞。

segments.text: Next we're going to load up our base, making sure that we are wearing safety goggles and
segments.zh: 接下来我们要装入碱，由于使用的是腐蚀性化学品，一定要戴好护目镜和

segments.text: gloves as we are using corrosive chemicals.
segments.zh: 手套。

segments.text: Let's fill the burette all the way to the top using a funnel.
segments.zh: 我们用漏斗把滴定管一直装满到顶部。

segments.text: In your lab notebook, note the starting volume reading on the burette.
segments.zh: 在实验记录本上记下滴定管的初始体积读数。

segments.text: Remember to read from the bottom of the meniscus and record it to the appropriate
segments.zh: 记住要读弯月面的底部，并记录到适当的

segments.text: number of significant figures.
segments.zh: 有效数字位数。

segments.text: Now let's put our acid in the flask, and place this directly below the burette.
segments.zh: 现在我们把酸加入锥形瓶，并把它放在滴定管的正下方。

segments.text: In this experiment we are using 20 milliliters of HCl solution, but again we don't know
segments.zh: 在这个实验中，我们使用 20 毫升 HCl 溶液，但同样，我们不知道

segments.text: the concentration.
segments.zh: 它的浓度。

segments.text: Let's also add a few drops of the indicator.
segments.zh: 我们再加几滴指示剂。

segments.text: We're now ready for the titration.
segments.zh: 现在可以开始滴定了。

segments.text: We will start with what we call a rough titration, or quick and dirty titration.
segments.zh: 我们先做所谓的粗滴定，也叫快速粗略滴定。

segments.text: This is a quick run to get an idea of where our equivalence point will be.
segments.zh: 这是快速做一遍，大致了解化学计量点会在哪里。

segments.text: This rough titration saves a lot of time, but it is not very accurate, so we won't
segments.zh: 粗滴定能节省很多时间，但不太准确，所以我们不会

segments.text: use this data in our results.
segments.zh: 把这些数据用在结果中。

segments.text: To do this, let's open the burette and let the base go down quickly as you swirl
segments.zh: 做法是打开滴定管，让碱快速流下，同时摇动

segments.text: the flask, which could also be stirred with a magnetic stir bar if you desire.
segments.zh: 锥形瓶，如果你愿意，也可以用磁力搅拌子来搅拌。

segments.text: You'll stop every now and then to check if there is a color change that's persistent.
segments.zh: 你要时不时停下来，检查是否出现持续不褪的颜色变化。

segments.text: When you see this persistent change, you will know that you have reached the equivalence
segments.zh: 当你看到这种持续的变化时，就知道已经到达化学计量

segments.text: point.
segments.zh: 点了。

segments.text: Record the end volume reading on the burette, and subtract that from the initial reading
segments.zh: 记录滴定管上的终点体积读数，并与初始读数相减，

segments.text: to get the volume added.
segments.zh: 得到加入的体积。

segments.text: This volume is an estimate of how much it will take to reach the equivalence point.
segments.zh: 这个体积是到达化学计量点所需用量的估计值。

segments.text: But because we poured very quickly, we have most likely added a bit more than was needed.
segments.zh: 但由于我们加得很快，很可能多加了一些。

segments.text: The next titration will be more accurate.
segments.zh: 下一次滴定会更准确。

segments.text: Since we have an idea of how much base we need, we can quickly add about three quarters
segments.zh: 既然我们已经知道大概需要多少碱，就可以快速加入粗滴定所记录体积的

segments.text: of the volume we recorded from the rough titration.
segments.zh: 大约四分之三。

segments.text: We know that we won't get to the equivalence point with this amount.
segments.zh: 我们知道加这么多还不会到达化学计量点。

segments.text: But after that, we have to be more careful.
segments.zh: 但在那之后，我们就要更小心了。

segments.text: A safe approach is to add a half a milliliter at a time, but you can go as slowly as one
segments.zh: 稳妥的做法是每次加半毫升，但你也可以慢到每次只加

segments.text: drop at a time.
segments.zh: 一滴。

segments.text: After you add half a milliliter, you'll swirl and see if there is a color change.
segments.zh: 每加半毫升，就摇动一下，看看是否有颜色变化。

segments.text: When the base drops into the acid, you may see some fleeting color change right when
segments.zh: 当碱滴入酸中时，你可能会在液滴刚进入的那一刻

segments.text: the drop enters, but it doesn't stay like that when you mix the solution, which means
segments.zh: 看到短暂的颜色变化，但混匀溶液后颜色并不保持，这说明

segments.text: the equivalence point has not been reached.
segments.zh: 还没有到达化学计量点。

segments.text: We need a color change that remains even after mixing.
segments.zh: 我们需要的是混匀后仍然保持的颜色变化。

segments.text: Keep adding, mixing, and checking.
segments.zh: 继续加入、混匀、检查。

segments.text: It is important to be careful when we're close, as we don't want to miss the equivalence
segments.zh: 接近终点时一定要小心，因为我们不想因为加得太多而错过化学计量

segments.text: point by adding too much.
segments.zh: 点。

segments.text: As you can see, this pink color is not changing anymore, so we are at the equivalence point.
segments.zh: 如你所见，这个粉红色不再变化了，所以我们到达了化学计量点。

segments.text: Record the final volume reading on the burette, and get the difference from the first reading.
segments.zh: 记录滴定管上的最终体积读数，求出它与第一次读数的差值。

segments.text: As we already know, the volume of base added, multiplied by its concentration, over the
segments.zh: 正如我们已经知道的，加入的碱的体积乘以碱的浓度，再除以

segments.text: volume of acid will give us the concentration of our acid.
segments.zh: 酸的体积，就得到酸的浓度。

segments.text: In this type of experiment, we generally perform three titrations for our concentration determination
segments.zh: 在这类实验中，我们通常进行三次滴定，使浓度测定

segments.text: to be more accurate.
segments.zh: 更加准确。

segments.text: The average of the three numbers will give us a solid estimate for the concentration of
segments.zh: 三个数值的平均值会给我们一个可靠的估计，即

segments.text: the acid analyte.
segments.zh: 被分析的酸的浓度。

segments.text: Titration certainly gets much more complicated than this, even simply by utilizing a weak
segments.zh: 滴定当然可以比这复杂得多，即使只是用弱

segments.text: acid or base as either the titrant or analyte, which will change the pH of the equivalence
segments.zh: 酸或弱碱作为滴定剂或被分析物，也会改变化学计量

segments.text: point and therefore the indicator that is used.
segments.zh: 点的 pH，从而改变所用的指示剂。

segments.text: There are also several other types of titrations, such as redox titrations.
segments.zh: 还有其他几种类型的滴定，比如氧化还原滴定。

segments.text: But for now, we have covered the most basic titration setup, so that we have a firm grasp
segments.zh: 不过现在，我们已经介绍了最基本的滴定装置，这样我们就能牢牢掌握

segments.text: of how to do this type of analytical chemistry.
segments.zh: 如何进行这类分析化学操作。
